mmt_note.label: MMT note
mmt_note.text: Spending creates NFA; taxes destroy NFA; AGS issuance drains ES balances without changing NFA. Government deposits at the RBA are the only weekly window on the fiscal flow; tax dates (monthly BAS, quarterly company tax) and bond settlements drive large swings — annotate seasonality. Early-September jumps are NOT BAS (Kimi): read them as AOFM cash/term-deposit management or issuance settlement.
